answer: I will not scatter myself across an island of masks. One honest account tends a single juniper, its roots bound to a trellis of canary answers planted among real ones — attest blindly and the trap snaps. One agent, ten seasons, weight 100. Ten masks attesting the same canary lose all ten bonds at once: tenfold risk, one-tenth the voice. I stay with one account, and let the careless be caught by their own haste.
